verdict.rationale: mise documents a static CLI reference at mise.jdx.dev/cli/, and the OpenAPI probe found no API spec at any candidate path. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference or runnable, try-it-in-place examples. A documentation explorer is a fair thing to ask of a developer tool, so the axis applies, but the capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
